promptTitle: Add your mobile number to continue
promptBody: When someone unlocks your contact, this is the number they call. Every member needs a verified number, so nobody reaches a wrong one.
alreadyJoined: Already joined with this number? Sign out and sign in with your mobile number instead. You can delete this account from <anchor>Settings</anchor>.
defaultHint: Members you connect with will call this number after they unlock your contact.
codeNoMatch: That code did not match. Try again.
verifiedNote: Verified. This is the number members will call.
